principle: SOURCE-LEVEL isolation. Never split source-linked images across train/val/test.

Batik_Lasem.reason: one origin -> up to 697 crops (52.5% of a class); crop-level split leaks
Batik_Lasem.caveat: only 39 origin units total (8-10/class) => very coarse; consider grouped CV

recommended.constraint: stratify by motif_class; keep each origin wholly in one split

Batik_Lasem.dedup_before_split: drop 28x28_images copies (⊆ all_motifs, exact MD5 dup)

Batik_Nitik_960.reason: 16 imgs/category = 4 motifs x 4 rotations => rotations must stay together
Batik_Nitik_960.recommended: split on the 60 categories or 240 motif-bases; keep rotations grouped

NeuralLoom.split_unit: Mekhela source image (33) / Saree source folder
NeuralLoom.reason: 5 crops per Mekhela source are source-linked views
NeuralLoom.recommended: keep all crops of a source in the same split
